title: MotionDirective
description: Motion variant of ViewDirective. Carries a nested MotionIntent, allowing the ML layer to schedule animations via the standard directive fan-out path.

kind.description: Discriminator value for the motion variant of ViewDirective.

motion_intent.description: Full nested MotionIntent envelope. Broker validates and routes as if directly emitted.

target_zone.description: Target zone for directive routing. Reuses ZoneId from ViewDirective.

ttl_ms.description: Optional time-to-live in milliseconds. Broker discards if not acted on within TTL.
